description: This file implements the DobbyContainer and DobbyContainerAdministrator classes, which manage container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and destruction within a process containerization framework. It interacts with Dobby proxy services over IPC, handles container info retrieval, and manages container state events.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle operations, IPC service initialization, and container destruction.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance, providing methods to start, stop, and retrieve container information.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on search paths and configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC service and Dobby proxy for container management.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up IPC service and proxy resources.

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Stops and destroys a container by name.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container with the given name is already running.

methods.name: containerStopCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, used to fulfill stop promises.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container's main process.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Provides memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Provides CPU/processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interface information (not implemented, returns nullptr).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.
